title: Iran Nuclear Activity Raises New Concerns
description:
On Bloomberg This Weekend, Council on Foreign Relations senior fellow Ray Takeyh says renewed Houthi attacks represent a significant setback for the US strategy of stabilizing regional oil flows and may indicate closer coordination between the group and Iran. Takeyh also tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that economic pressure has failed to force Tehran to change course, as new construction at the deeply buried Pickaxe Mountain complex raises questions about the future of Iran's nuclear program.
